description: Returns the current status of an async wiki generation job. Call after generate_wiki with async=true; spares the calling agent or CI pipeline a blocking wait while a large module renders. WHEN NOT TO USE: do not poll for synchronous results — omit async=true on generate_wiki instead. Returns job_id, status (pending/complete/failed), wiki_doc (when complete), error (when failed).

job_id.description: Job ID returned by a prior generate_wiki call with async=true.

name: get_generation_status
